objective: Fix V3.3 defects: (1) passage-grounded 102 with exact passage citation, (2) inherency firewall (NECESSARY only), (3) arrangement firewall, (4) independent 103 with ObviousnessEvidenceV34, (5) false-reject forensic on 7 V3.3 cases.

root_causes: 102_FAILURE: 7 cases — NOVELTY_ADVERSARY too aggressive, anticipating granted patents without exact passage citation
103_FAILURE: 15% accuracy — 103 not independent from 102, no real COULD/WOULD distinction
FALSE_REJECT: 4 cases — 102 overclaim on granted patents

v3_4_changes_from_v3_3: PASSAGE-GROUNDED 102: every claim limitation requires limitation_id + reference_id + disclosure_type + exact_passage + claim_number/paragraph + mapping_rationale + mapping_confidence
Disclosure types restricted to: EXPRESS / NECESSARILY_INHERENT / NOT_DISCLOSED / UNCERTAIN. Forbidden: POSSIBLE / PLAUSIBLE / TOPICAL / SEMANTICALLY_SIMILAR
INHERENCY FIREWALL: inherency requires NECESSARY (not LIKELY/PROBABLE/POSSIBLE). Machine assertion: inherency_necessity_proof. If missing: NOT_DISCLOSED/UNCERTAIN.
ARRANGEMENT FIREWALL: verify reference discloses REQUIRED RELATIONSHIPS, not just elements. A disclosed + B disclosed != A+B arranged as claimed.

NoveltyEvidenceV34 decision object: single_reference + all_limitations_mapped + all_relationships_mapped + passage_evidence + inherency_necessity + arrangement_supported + uncertainties + final_result
102_KILL legal only if: all_limitations_mapped=TRUE AND all_relationships_mapped=TRUE AND all_mapping_types in {EXPRESS, NECESSARILY_INHERENT} AND uncertainty_count=0

FALSE-REJECT FORENSIC: audit 7 V3.3 false-reject cases. For each: old_102_mapping + correct_mapping + bad_inference + source_passage + root_cause. Classify: ELEMENT_OVERCLAIM / ARRANGEMENT_OVERCLAIM / INHERENCY_ERROR / REFERENCE_MISMATCH / CLAIM_INTERPRETATION_ERROR / LLM_JUDGMENT_ERROR

ObviousnessEvidenceV34: closest_prior_art + objective_problem + difference_elements + secondary_reference + motivation + technical_compatibility + reasonable_expectation + teaching_away + could + would + why + technical_effect + hindsight
COULD/WOULD RULE: 103 requires COULD=TRUE AND WOULD=TRUE AND MOTIVATION_SUPPORTED=TRUE AND EXPECTED_SUCCESS_SUPPORTED=TRUE. If any missing: 103=INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (not OBVIOUSNESS_RISK).

INDEPENDENT 103 PATH: 103 adversary does NOT see generator rationale, commercial rationale, or final invention explanation. Receives only: canonical claim + verified evidence + prior-art mappings + technical context.
PRE-DISCLOSURE / POST-DISCLOSURE: Pass A (hide novelty thesis) vs Pass B (reveal full claim). Compare motivation, difference, combination, expected success. Large divergence = HINDSIGHT_RISK_HIGH.
CITED_ART_MAPPING_ACCURACY: for each calibration case with examiner-cited reference, system must reproduce cited reference + claim mapping + reason it matters. Recall alone is not enough.

SEARCH RECALL: target >=80%. For missed references, identify: query-family miss / terminology miss / classification miss / citation miss / semantic miss / source failure. Fix relevant search family, not aggregate number.

novelty_102_rules.passage_required: Every claim limitation requires exact_passage citation from the reference
novelty_102_rules.inherency_firewall: NECESSARY only. Not LIKELY/PROBABLE/POSSIBLE. Requires inherency_necessity_proof.
novelty_102_rules.arrangement_firewall: Verify reference discloses REQUIRED RELATIONSHIPS. A+B disclosed != A+B arranged as claimed.
novelty_102_rules.102_kill_legal_only_if: all_limitations_mapped=TRUE AND all_relationships_mapped=TRUE AND all_mapping_types in {EXPRESS, NECESSARILY_INHERENT} AND uncertainty_count=0

obviousness_103_rules.independent_path: 103 adversary does NOT see generator/commercial rationale. Receives only: canonical claim + verified evidence + prior-art mappings + technical context.
obviousness_103_rules.could_would_rule: 103 requires COULD=TRUE AND WOULD=TRUE AND MOTIVATION_SUPPORTED=TRUE AND EXPECTED_SUCCESS_SUPPORTED=TRUE. If any missing: 103=INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
obviousness_103_rules.two_pass: Pass A (hide novelty thesis) vs Pass B (reveal full claim). Large divergence = HINDSIGHT_RISK_HIGH.

stop_rule: DO NOT run 50->5 until V3.4 reaches all thresholds including 102>=85% and 103>=80%.
